name: zinn
description: Zinn task keys in the Claude Code transcript and a Zinn pane. Under each reply, a status mark and a short title for every task key it mentions, with a key the store lacks flagged. /zinn-show opens a task, a board or the list of boards. Reads the store by argv, renews this session's own claims after turns that ran a tool and, when asked, releases them as the session ends: no tool, no prompt section, no model turn, so it costs no tokens.

enabled.title: Decorate keys
enabled.description: Off draws nothing and does not read the store.

look.title: Look
look.description: suffix: ' · ◐ title' after the key. brackets: ' [◐ title]' after the key. colour: like suffix, key bold, status mark coloured, title dim. under: the text untouched, one legend under it (see legend). off. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_LOOK, else under. Prefer the variable: a /config change writes the user settings.

legend.title: Legend style
legend.description: How the line under a reply is laid out (look under only). spaced: '↳ KEY ◐ title   KEY ○ title'. brackets: '↳ [KEY ◐ title] [KEY ○ title]'. dots: entries separated by ' · '. stacked: one entry per line, keys padded to align (the default). from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_LEGEND, else stacked.

maxEntries.title: Entries per legend
maxEntries.description: At most this many entries per legend block, then one dim '+N more' line. Applies to every legend style. A whole number: 0 or 1000 and up means no cap. An unknown key is never hidden by the cap. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_MAX_ENTRIES, else 5.

keyPress.title: Press on a legend key
keyPress.description: What a click on the key of a stacked legend line does (look under, legend stacked). button (the default): the key is a button. link: the key is a Markdown link to the placeholder https://zinn.invalid/KEY, drawn with the raw address in brackets, and a ctrl-click opens that dead address. off: plain text. A press opens the pane on that task, and clicks reach it only in the fullscreen terminal. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_KEY_PRESS, else button.

marks.title: Status mark
marks.description: shapes: ○ ◐ ◑ ⊘ ● (▪ archived). words: todo, in progress, review, blocked, done. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_MARKS, else shapes.

titleLength.title: Title length
titleLength.description: Characters of the task title shown after the key (an ellipsis counts as one). 0 shows the status mark only.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Comma-separated project keys to decorate (for example ABC,XYZ). Empty decorates every project in the store. A key of another project is neither decorated nor flagged.

myPrompts.title: My own prompts
myPrompts.description: leave (the default): your own prompts are drawn as typed, with no line under them. To turn decoration of your prompts on, choose decorate here, or set the environment variable ZINN_MENTIONS_MY_PROMPTS=decorate before starting Claude Code. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_MY_PROMPTS, else leave. Choosing leave here also keeps the plugin out of your prompts' drawing entirely.

tailGuardMs.title: Tail guard (ms)
tailGuardMs.description: Replies only: a key at the very end of a streaming reply is drawn plain until the text has stood still this long (a streaming SAM-2 may become SAM-27). 0 turns it off.

log.title: Timing log
log.description: Write counts and timings (never transcript text) to the folder below. ZINN_MENTIONS_LOG=1 turns it on too.

pollSeconds.title: Live key map: poll (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: Every this many seconds the plugin runs one CLI call (zinn activity list --limit 1 --json, about 260 ms, no tokens) and reloads the key map only when the newest activity id changed: a write from another session or your own terminal. 0 turns the poll off. A value from 1 to 4 is raised to 5. The plugin also refreshes at once after a zinn write made through this session's Bash tool. That part has no option. While the session is idle the gap doubles after each check, up to 10 minutes, and the next turn or tool call checks at once and restores the interval. At the default of 30: about 120 calls per session-hour in use, 9 in the first idle hour and 6 in each idle hour after.

toastOnChange.title: Toast when a key changes column
toastOnChange.description: A toast such as 'ABC-7 -> Review' when a refresh finds a key in a different board column than before. Reloads from /zinn refresh never toast. Set false to silence.

logDir.title: Log folder
logDir.description: Absolute folder for the timing log, created on the first write. Empty: <home>/.zinn/traces/zinn, where <home> is HOME then USERPROFILE. Never a folder inside the plugin tree (a --plugin-dir session watches it and reloads) and never one inside a repository.

statusLine.title: Line under the prompt
statusLine.description: When a line is pinned under the prompt. problems (the default): only while something is wrong (no key map, RESTART NEEDED, the log failed). always: the look, the key count and the timing at all times. off: never. The engine draws a pinned line as a notice with a warning mark, so a line that is always there reads as a fault. /zinn alone says the same in a toast. from-env reads ZINN_MENTIONS_STATUS_LINE.

footerLabel.title: Footer label
footerLabel.description: One dim word, zinn, among the mode labels at the right of the prompt footer: the sign that the plugin is loaded (zinn ✗ while something is wrong). Off draws no label.

footerClaim.title: Claimed task in the footer label
footerClaim.description: While this session holds a claim, the footer label names the task: zinn ◆ ABC-7, with +N when it holds more. It comes from the key map the plugin already loads and costs no tokens. Needs the footer label.

claimNotices.title: Notices about this session's claims
claimNotices.description: A toast a few minutes before a claim this session holds runs out (5 minutes, or a tenth of a lease shorter than 50 minutes), a notice when one has run out, and after /clear a notice naming the claims the cleared conversation still holds. In a session with no screen, the same warning is a native notification. It comes from the key map the plugin already loads, makes no write and costs no tokens.

renewClaims.title: Renew this session's claims
renewClaims.description: After a turn that ran a tool, each claim this session holds with less than half its lease left is renewed with zinn task heartbeat KEY, one CLI call (no tokens). A claim that has run out is never renewed, so its notice still shows. When the CLI refuses (another session holds the task, the claim saw no change to the task for 24 hours, or it has no claim any more), one toast says so and that task is not renewed again this session. While idle: no calls. While in use, per held claim: at most 4 calls per session-hour on a 30m lease, 1 on a 2h lease. Each renewal is a write, so the next database check also reloads the key map once. Off makes no write.

releaseClaims.title: Release this session's claims at the end
releaseClaims.description: When the session ends for any reason but /clear or a resume, each claim this session still holds is released with zinn task release KEY: one CLI call per held claim, all at once at the end of the session and none at any other time (no tokens). The end of a session has a short time limit shared with every plugin, so a release it cuts off is left to the lease. Off (the default) makes no write.

pane.title: Zinn pane
pane.description: Off registers no /zinn-show command and opens no pane. A press on a legend key then says so in a toast.

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: How a task's overview is laid out in the pane. table: dense aligned columns, nothing wraps (the default). card: a compact card of five or six rows. sectioned: labelled fields, relations with titles, a longer description. from-env reads ZINN_TASK_PANE_LAYOUT, else table. Prefer the variable or the in-pane switch: a /config change writes the user settings.
